references.text: He lies down, he rests like a lion and like a lioness—who dares to rouse him? Blessed is the one who blesses you, and cursed is the one who curses you!
Behold, a people rises up like a lioness; it lifts itself up like a young lion. It does not lie down until it has devoured its prey and drunk the blood of those it has slain.
A lament over the princes of Israel: What was your mother? A lioness among lions! She lay down among the young lions and reared her cubs.
The remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep.
For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, a tribe about which Moses said nothing concerning priests.
And one of the elders says to me: Do not weep! Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered, so that he can open the scroll and its seven seals.
The lion, the strongest among the beasts, who does not turn back before any.
For I will be like a lion to Ephraim, like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, yes I, will tear in pieces and go away; I will carry off, and no one can rescue.
